funnel.figureLabel: Token funnel: raw shell output falls through RTK, caveman and graphify and leaves as fewer, brighter particles
funnel.sourceMeasured: Measured: 1.3M tokens kept out of context over 24,431 shell commands, 14.6% total. One developer, one workload, author's machine, Sep–Nov 2026; November is a partial month, so read it as a trend, not a benchmark. Source: README, Measured, not promised.
funnel.sourceClaim: Claim: RTK compresses shell output for 15–30% fewer input tokens, transparently. Source: docs/01-architecture.md. Not a measurement.
funnel.illustrative: Particle counts are illustrative. Only the RTK figure comes from the repo; caveman and graphify savings are not measured here yet.
